headline: 绿灯军团双榜称霸，影剧市场蓄势待发
headlineEn: Green Lantern Corps dominates both charts; film & TV market poised for launch
summary: 今日零新片，但《绿灯军团》强势登顶电影热榜，电视剧《特别行动：母狮》也引发追剧潮；本周共有4部新片，且《最后的日出》备受期待。
summaryEn: No new movies today, but Green Lantern Corps tops the film chart while TV drama Special Ops: Lioness sparks a binge wave; four new films arrive this week, and The Last Sunrise is highly anticipated.
